column1: # OLED substitution table for the PVE/PBS UniFi theme (themes/theme-unifi.css).
# kind=rgb  decimal triple inside rgb(), whitespace-insensitive
# kind=lit  exact token, for rgba() where the alpha changes too
# Backgrounds: base goes true black, surfaces drop to a near-black ladder.
# Secondary text lifts to stay legible against true black.
# Accent brightens; the focus ring also needs more alpha over black.
# The base ships two near-identical blues (#006EFF and #006fff); both map across.
